caption: The drawing shows a rectangular panel with a decorative border at the top and bottom edges, each colored light green with gray shading for dimensional effect. Inside the panel, there is an elaborate symmetrical design consisting of various twisting and curving black vines and stems, from which green leaves and clusters of small red flowers or berries emerge. The background within the border is a pale beige or off-white, providing contrast to the colorful plant motif. The design fills most of the central area, and the overall drawing is centered on a plain, lightly speckled background. The name "ISABELLA. RUTH. DOERFLER." is written in red, capitalized letters on the lower right corner outside the central panel.
title: Small Decorated Box (front view)
